headline: Microsoft confirms Windows updates causing SQL Server performance issues
summary: Microsoft confirmed that Windows updates released since the October 2026 Patch Tuesday are causing SQL Server performance and stability problems, including linked server connections that fail to close properly.

claims.statement: Microsoft confirmed Windows updates since the October 2026 Patch Tuesday are causing SQL Server performance and stability issues.

sources.quote: Windows updates released since the October 2026 Patch Tuesday are causing SQL Server performance and stability issues
Microsoft admits SQL Servers might wobble after October update

claims.statement: The issue involves linked server connections that persist longer than expected.

sources.quote: Linked server connections can linger long past their welcome
